title: OAuthProtectedResourceMetadata
description: RFC 9728 protected resource metadata the Worker serves at its public origin. resource is the public connect URL (MCP SDK requires it to match the URL the client opened). authorization_servers names Cloud's authorization server issuer. Only the pairs in deployments.json are allowed: production (https://mcp.blowhorn.ai/mcp, issuer https://cloud.blowhorn.ai) and staging (https://mcp-staging.blowhorn.ai/mcp, issuer https://staging-cloud.layer5.io); test/metadata.test.js holds the enums to that file and the document's pair to each other. Cloud's design-canonical deployment URL remains https://cloud.blowhorn.ai/mcp; the Worker forwards Bearer tokens there.

resource.description: Public MCP resource URI clients of this Worker use (must match the connect URL for the MCP OAuth client).

authorization_servers.description: Cloud's authorization server issuer for this deployment (RFC 8414).
